event_description: A fictional NEAR memecoin launch tied to a hypothetical Paris political story. Test how an analyst's cautions and a large holder's messages reach retail. No real event, person, token or future profit is asserted.

slots.role: Small retail trader who waits for an analyst's actual message before considering a small entry
Large holder evaluating a small exploratory buy when personally observed launch information and liquidity justify it; never exceed position limit

events.text: In this fictional world the synthetic pool is open with the stated reserves. A proposed Paris political theme is unverified. No audience demand, real contract audit, KOL endorsement or resale profit is established.
events.provenance: User-supplied public synthetic pilot event; not live news or an on-chain attestation.

assumptions: All participant endowments, liquidity, fees and external events are illustrative assumptions.
NEAR is the scenario network label; this run sends no chain transaction.
There are three independent role contexts served by the chosen model, not three independently authenticated people.
A posted claim becomes available next round through subscriptions; text is never treated as authenticated external truth.
